name: explore
instruction: Investigate an important uncertainty. Preserve a finding with its evidence and limits; a new question alone is not a discovery.

name: finish
instruction: Resume an existing commitment. Seek a verifiable completion or an evidence-backed decision to abandon it; declaring more goals is not completion.

name: simplify
instruction: Look for repeated friction or unused structure. Improve or retire something only when the evidence warrants it. Another organizer is not automatically an improvement.
